# Synthetic media for context evaluation

`printed.jpg` is a generated text image:

```text
Saturday ideas
Buy lemons and fresh bread.
Call Maya at 3:30.
Keep the original words.
```

`speech.m4a` is synthesized English speech: “Remember to buy lemons and fresh bread, call Maya at three thirty, keep the original words.”

These fixtures contain no real user data and are intentionally checked in for repeatability. They exercise private upload, extraction/transcription, note creation and shared enrichment. They do not benchmark real camera captures, handwriting or microphone conditions.
